EmailTemplate.name: Customize your Reserach Preferences
EmailTemplate.subject: Eurasia Group | Customize your research preferences
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
I'm writing to kindly remind you to review and adjust your email subscription preferences for the Eurasia Group content you wish to receive.
{!Contact.Preferences_Management_URL_w_Email_check__c} or use the “click here” link that can be found at the bottom of all our research emails.
You may also navigate through Eurasia Group’s client portal at library.eurasiagroup.net and log in with your credentials, by following the steps below:
Go to the “User” icon on the top right corner of the portal and select “Preferences.” Expand the sections to have a detailed view of the publications. Check or uncheck the boxes next to the titles, and then click on the “Save” icon at the bottom of the page. Do not forget to update your contact information (First/Last Name, City, Title, and Phone) by editing the "My Profile" section.
Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any queries.
Best Regards, EG Sales Operations
